title: Upper density of Hausdorff content (Simon Ch. 1, 3.26(2)) in cover form
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ℓ > 0 and let A ⊆ ℝ^P be a bounded Borel set. Then the set of x ∈ A for which the following property fails has μH[ℓ] outer measure 0: for every δ > 0 there is ρ ∈ (0, δ) such that every countable cover {C_j}_{j∈ℕ} of A ∩ B_ρ(x) satisfies ρ^ℓ ≤ 2·Σ_j (diam C_j)^ℓ, with diameters in [0, ∞] and diam ∅ = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < ℓ → MeasurableSet A → Bornology.IsBounded A → μH[ℓ] {x | x ∈ A ∧ ¬ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < δ ∧ ∀ C : ℕ → Set (Euclid P), A ∩ ball x ρ ⊆ ⋃ j, C j → ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ ℓ ≤ 2 * ∑' j, Metric.ediam (C j) ^ ℓ} = 0
